algorithm.description: VA does not add disability ratings. Sort all individual ratings descending. Starting with combined=0, for each rating r (in descending order): combined = combined + (100 - combined) * (r / 100). After combining all ratings, apply the rounding rule below.
algorithm.iteration_order: descending (largest disability rating applied first, per 4.25(a) — 'the disabilities will be arranged in the exact order of severity, beginning with the greatest disability')

rounding_rule.description: Round the final combined value to the nearest 10 percent. Values ending in digits 1-4 round DOWN; values ending in digits 5-9 round UP. This means a value ending in exactly 5 rounds UP (not the common 'round half to even' or 'round half down' convention).
rounding_rule.example: 50% + 30% combined = 65% (50 + 30*(100-50)/100 = 65), which rounds UP to 70%, not down to 60%.

verified_fixtures.note: 50+30*(50/100)=65, ends in 5, rounds up to 70. Verified via military.com worked example.

30+20*(70/100)=44 (running); 44+10*(56/100)=49.6, ends in .6 (treat as 9-range for VA integer rounding — VA table works in whole-percent combined values in practice, so verify against official Table I when implementing; documented here as the formula-derived value, flag for extra fixture verification against the actual Table I chart since 3+ condition combination amplifies any rounding-boundary ambiguity).

50+30*(50/100)=65 (running, pre-round intermediate values are NOT rounded per-step, only final); 65+20*(35/100)=72, ends in 2, rounds down to 70. Matches military.com's PTSD/knee/tinnitus worked example (50/30/20 -> 72% -> rounds to 70%).

coverage_note: Formula and rounding rule confirmed via military.com worked examples (60+30->72->70%, and 50+30+20->72->70%) which are described as directly reflecting the official Table I. The [30,20,10] fixture's exact Table I value was NOT independently confirmed against the raw eCFR table (eCFR/GovInfo blocked programmatic fetch, see access notes) — implementation should treat this fixture as formula-derived-and-plausible rather than officially verified, and re-verify against a rendered copy of Table I before shipping if possible.
access_notes: eCFR.gov and GovInfo.gov both blocked automated fetch of the raw Table I (bot-protection page). The formula + rounding rule were instead corroborated via military.com's published worked examples, which explicitly walk through VA's official methodology and match the 38 CFR 4.25 text description found via search. Recommend a manual spot-check against a rendered eCFR page before production launch.
